'''2012 Bespin Regionals Brian Herold DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|Combat Readiness / Full Scale Alert (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
